children: Sasol Financing International Limited will accept all valid tenders for $737.8M of Sasol Financing USA LLC’s $750M 2027 convertible bonds, with no pro rata scaling. Settlement is expected around 24 November 2026, subject to conditions.
About 98.4% of the originally issued principal is being repurchased, substantially reducing the bonds outstanding.
The premium is a key cost of the tender; accrued interest is additional.
Settlement remains subject to the financing and invitation settlement conditions.
The issuer intends to use a clean-up call to redeem the remainder at principal plus accrued unpaid interest.

This is a late-stage update to the previously announced repurchase invitation, with nearly all of the 2027 bonds tendered. Completion of settlement and the intended clean-up call are the next steps, both subject to the stated conditions.
from Sasol Financing USA LLC distributed by EQS.
